description: This file defines the interface for high-resolution time manipulation functions, including obtaining current time, computing elapsed time, comparing times, and converting time to string or timespec formats. It contains type definitions, function prototypes, and documentation comments.

methods.name: rtTime_Now
methods.description: Retrieves the current system time into the provided rtTime_t structure.

methods.name: rtTime_Later
methods.description: Calculates a future time by adding specified milliseconds to a given time or current time if null.

methods.name: rtTime_Elapsed
methods.description: Calculates the milliseconds elapsed between start and end times.

methods.name: rtTime_Compare
methods.description: Compares two time values, returning -1, 0, or 1 based on their chronological order.

methods.name: rtTime_ToString
methods.description: Converts a time value to a human-readable string in HH:MM:SS.mmm format.

methods.name: rtTime_ToTimespec
methods.description: Converts a time value to a timespec structure suitable for functions like pthread_cond_timedwait.
